item.tib: spyi 'dul rta dbu dmar chung gi byin rlabs dbang gi yid bzhin 'dod 'byung
item.coloph: rma gnyen gser sgrom ba'i yang snying*/ zab gter brgyad kyis (kyi) yang tig zhi khro yongs rdzogs spyi 'dul gyi dbang khrid/ yid bzhin 'dod 'byung zhes bya ba 'di/ bla ma snga rabs rnams kyi (kyis) mdzad byang dang*/ gzhung la sogs nas sdus (bsdus) nas/ dpal ldan zangs ri ru/ sum pa g.yung drung rgyal pa'i (bas)bsgrigs pa/ 'gal 'khrul spyi 'dul zhi khro'i dbyings su bshags/ dge ba'i 'gro kun sangs rgyas brgyar thob shog
